headline: Gold Drops Near $4,000 as Oil Prices Rise and Inflation Persists
summary: Spot gold fell below $4,000 an ounce as rising oil prices and persistent U.S. inflation reinforced expectations of Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
why: Gold is traditionally viewed as an inflation hedge and a safe-haven asset, but higher interest rates increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Rising rate expectations and stronger oil-driven inflation indicators reduce demand for non-yielding precious metals.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of tighter monetary policy and higher yields strengthen the dollar and increase the opportunity cost for bullion holders.
